name: tests-25pct-python-socketio-parameterized-namespace-routes
instr:
Support reusable parameterized namespaces for synchronous/asynchronous server and client class handlers.

NamespaceRoute exposes template and ordered parameter_names. Reject relative/empty templates and duplicate parameter names with InvalidNamespaceRoute(ValueError), retaining template. Match complete namespaces only, rejecting missing/extra segments. Matches expose the original concrete namespace and URL-decoded parameters. Parameter mappings are independent and reject mutation with TypeError. specificity compares literal-segment count, then depth. Successful matches expose `namespace` and `parameters` attributes.

Registrations return active NamespaceRegistration receipts exposing route. unregister returns True once, then False, removes only its route and allows client catch-all fallback without transport. Indistinguishable server templates raise NamespaceRouteConflict(ValueError) containing first_template/second_template and leave prior routing usable. Same-template replacement deactivates the old receipt and affects later resolutions; previously resolved bindings retain their handler. Exact server handlers and replacements retain priority over routes/catch-all. Unmatched server namespaces retain catch-all arguments.

During dispatch, route_params and route_namespace identify the concrete binding; outside dispatch they raise LookupError. Nested synchronous server dispatch restores the outer binding. Synchronous clients, asynchronous server coroutines and regular asynchron
